title: Optimized Optimization
description: Higher FPS for vanilla Minecraft with no changes
body:
**Optimized Optimization is a Minecraft modpack made for one simple purpose: making vanilla Minecraft run better.**

**It includes only performance-focused mods that improve FPS, reduce lag, and make the game feel smoother without changing the vanilla gameplay. No extra content, no gameplay tweaks, just pure optimization for a better Minecraft experience.**
